def test_median():
    # Odd number of elements
    assert median([3, 1, 2]) == 2
    assert median([5]) == 5
    assert median([10, 20, 30, 40, 50]) == 30

    # Even number of elements (average of middle two)
    assert median([1, 2, 3, 4]) == 2.5
    assert median([1, 2]) == 1.5
    assert median([4, 2]) == 3.0

    # Unsorted input should be handled
    assert median([9, 1, 5, 3, 7]) == 5
    assert median([10, 2, 8, 4]) == 6.0

    # Duplicates
    assert median([2, 2, 2, 2]) == 2.0
    assert median([1, 2, 2, 3, 4]) == 2

    # Negative numbers and floats
    assert median([-5, -1, -3]) == -3
    assert median([-1.5, 2.5]) == 0.5
    assert median([1.1, 2.2, 3.3]) == 2.2

    # Even-length list with duplicates around the middle
    assert median([1, 2, 2, 3]) == 2.0

    print("All median tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_median()
